# API guide

`create_user(name, email, timeout, retries)` accepts a name and email.
The default timeout is 30.
The default retries is 3.
Run the CLI with `--retries`.
Set the `API_KEY` environment variable.
See `src/api.py`.
Requires Python 3.12 or newer.

fake_function(nope) accepts this
